highlighted_projects.description: Developed a Python-based photo editing tool with advanced colour replacement capabilities. Manipulated colour space data using NumPy and SciPy matrix transformations to isolate and replace specific colour ranges within images. Integrated a fuzzy selection feature with adjustable sensitivity thresholds for precise colour targeting. Implemented lossless upscaling algorithms based on mathematical interpolation techniques to preserve image fidelity. Designed an intuitive PySimpleGUI interface to enhance accessibility for non-technical users.
highlighted_projects.name: Image Filter and Effects App

highlighted_projects.description: Led a team of 3 developers in a high-pressure hackathon environment, coordinating task delegation and sprint planning to deliver a Granite AI-powered staffing optimization tool for healthcare settings. Engineered a robust Python data pipeline to validate and standardize input data, ensuring consistency across the system. Implemented advanced prompt engineering techniques to fine-tune Granite AI responses, achieving a 25%+ reduction in average simulated patient wait times.
highlighted_projects.name: Hospital Staffing Level AI Prediction tool

jarvis_projects.description: Developed a metrics collection and storage system for Linux cluster monitoring. Leveraged Bash scripts to extract, process, and store hardware and usage metrics. Deployed a Dockerized PostgreSQL database for persistent data storage. Streamlined deployment workflows through automated database provisioning and management scripts, reducing setup time. Scheduled automated data collection using Crontab.
jarvis_projects.name: Cluster Monitor

jarvis_projects.description: Developed a Java application modeled after the Linux grep utility that recursively searches target directories to output lines matching a user-specified regex pattern to a destination file. Utilized Java lambdas and streams to scale the application and efficiently handle large file sizes. Built a robust test suite using JUnit, managed project dependencies with Maven, and containerized the application with Docker to publish it directly to Docker Hub for seamless deployment.
jarvis_projects.name: Java Grep App

jarvis_projects.description: Ingested two years of anonymous retail data from a UK-based gift shop into a Dockerized PostgreSQL database, then cleaned and transformed the dataset using Python, NumPy, and Pandas to identify strategies for driving stagnant revenue. Based on these findings, designed and delivered a stakeholder presentation that highlighted a major, untapped non-home market and outlined actionable next steps to capitalize on the opportunity.
jarvis_projects.name: Python analytics project

summary: I am a software developer with a B.Sc. in Computer Science (Co-op) from Ontario Tech University, currently pivoting into data engineering. After a hackathon sparked my interest in the field, I began building my data skillset. At Jarvis, I design and implement various projects such as analyzing retail data to help a gift shop maximize its revenue. Previously, I taught coding concepts to children ages 5–15 at Code Ninjas, earning consistently high reviews from children and parents. I love data engineering because it combines my passion for problem solving with the puzzle of transforming messy, unstructured data into clean, actionable insights.
